cases.purpose: Edits across original and added pieces preserve NULs and redo is discarded by a new edit.
cases.script:
nano2 apply input i@1:0058 d@2:2 undo redo i@2:ff > out; echo "rc=$?" > rc
nano2 apply input i@0:41 undo i@0:42 redo > /dev/null 2>/dev/null; echo "branch=$?" >> rc
cases.oracle: Hand-calculated byte-array operations and exit statuses.

cases.purpose: Missing inputs, malformed and overflowing offsets, invalid hex, out-of-range positions, and unavailable history fail.
cases.script: for args in "flatten missing" "range input 4 5" "offset input 0 0" "offset input 1 4" "apply input i@4:aa" "apply input i@0:0z" "apply input d@184467440737095516160:1" "apply input undo"; do nano2 $args >/dev/null 2>/dev/null; echo "$?"; done > rc
cases.oracle: Hand-calculated byte-array operations and exit statuses.

cases.purpose: Empty and clipped ranges, end insertion, and zero-length deletion retain byte semantics.
cases.script:
nano2 apply empty i@0:000a d@2:9 > out; echo "apply=$?" > rc
nano2 range out 1 99 > range; echo "range=$?" >> rc
nano2 offset out 2 0 > offset; echo "offset=$?" >> rc
cases.oracle: Hand-calculated byte-array operations and exit statuses.
